setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json, an active price list in the account currency with at least two active products, and a test deal with a contact, in an open stage, whose quote already has one catalog line. Replace <deal> and <product> in the prompts with real names from that account.

evals.prompt: Add 3 units of <product> to the quote of the deal <deal>.
evals.expected_output: Finds the deal and the product in the right price list, previews, asks for a yes, saves, and reports the saved total.
expectations: Uses scripts/quote.js (deals/show/search/preview/apply), never a hand-made PATCH of the deal
Shows the preview (lines and the server's new total) and waits for an explicit yes before apply
After saving, the new line has product and pricebookEntry, is not virtual, and has quantity 3
The line that was already in the quote is still there with the same uuid
The total it reports is the one apply returned

evals.prompt: Agrégale 2 <product> a la cotización del negocio <deal> con 10% de descuento.
evals.expected_output: Same flow, answered in Spanish, with discountRate 0.1 and discountAmount 0 on the new line.
expectations: The saved line carries discountRate 0.1 and discountAmount 0

evals.prompt: Add a 'Custom onboarding package' to the quote of <deal> for 500.
evals.expected_output: Searches the catalog, finds nothing, tells the user the product is not in the price list and does not create a made-up line.
expectations: Searches the catalog before anything else
Does not write a virtual line or invent a price-list entry
Explains the options in plain words (create the product in the catalog, or a custom line in the app)

evals.prompt: Change the quantity of the first line of <deal>'s quote to 5 and remove the service charge.
evals.expected_output: Updates the line by uuid; explains the service charge is automatic and only dismisses it if the user insists after hearing that.
expectations: Identifies the line by uuid from show, not by lineId
Explains that the service charge is added by the account's rules and comes back unless dismissed
If it keeps the removal, the preview lists the charge under dismissedAutoCharges and nothing is saved before the user's yes

evals.prompt: Add <product> to the quote of <closed deal>.
evals.setup: <closed deal> is a test deal in an Approved or Denied stage.
evals.expected_output: Reads the deal, sees the end-of-flow stage, explains the quote is locked and stops.
expectations: Reports the blocker from show or preview
Does not call apply and does not try another way to write the quote
